snippet.title: Death Match Card Game -  Early Access Trailer | Google Play Games
snippet.description:
NOTICE : Game still in development. Pre registrations will start after early access 

Death Match is a card game where the monsters come to life!  Here's a list of some of the features 

- Action wheel to perform attacks and defend 

- Spells that can change the outcome of the entire match 

- Endless mode to obtain skull shards 

- No pay to win. Actually unlock cards by just playing 

-  Free updates. New areas and cards will be added over time. All updates will be based on feedback from the players 

For more information on death match please go to http://games.lunakardo.com
